objective: Harden the Domain 11 physical/HIL cross-system path so authentication, device configuration, telemetry availability, and safety boundaries are represented truthfully across frontend and backend.

acceptance_criteria.description: Authenticated frontend waits for a Firebase ID token before protected API requests.
Missing device configuration or authoritative telemetry is shown as unavailable; the frontend does not fabricate sensor defaults.
Device claiming provisions a safe durable configuration with manual control mode and outputs disabled.
Configuration synchronization exposes the actual revision and convergence state reported by the backend.
Physical actuator safety boundaries are preserved; no test requires actuator activation or emergency-stop bypass.
Physical HIL is not declared fully PASS unless the deployed physical path is observed end-to-end.
